name: WordHavoc
summary:
WordHavoc brings classic word search into the arcade!

Race against the clock, find hidden words, and challenge yourself to beat your personal best. With a colorful 10×10 letter grid, 40 word categories, and over 1,000 words to discover, there's always another puzzle waiting.

Take on six increasingly challenging rounds in Arcade Mode, where every second counts. Find words to keep the clock running, build combos to boost your score, and see if you can make it all the way to the finish!

Looking for something different? Endless Mode lets you keep playing and see how long you can survive, while Relaxed Mode removes the time pressure so you can search for words at your own pace.
